run_doctest_tuple: run the doctest suite for Boost.Python tuple extension module tests
test_convert_to_tuple: test converting a string to a tuple of individual characters using the tuple extension
test_tuple_operators: test tuple concatenation operators by combining two tuples and printing results
test_make_tuple_empty: test creating an empty tuple using the make_tuple function from the extension
test_make_tuple_with_args: test creating a tuple with mixed arguments like strings and integers
